plan.title: Material PR to Split Award PO

steps.note: Enable split awarding for the case.
Enable RFx project creation from purchase requisitions.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Confirm the RFQ template was applied.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Invite two QA vendors without inventing supplier names.

args.goal: Add one required Terms and Conditions clause to the event and leave the create screen showing the saved clause

steps.note: Add the required T&C clause, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.

args.goal: Open the event schedule, set the evaluation duration to 30 minutes, save the schedule, and leave the create screen showing the committed schedule

steps.note: Set the requested evaluation duration, which is not parameterized by set_schedule.
Publish the RFQ after all required setup is complete.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Have the first invited QA vendor submit a quote of 100 from the vendor portal.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was submitted.
Have the second invited QA vendor submit a quote of 90 from the vendor portal.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was submitted.
Wait for bidding to end before comparison and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding closes.
Confirm both bidding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Confirm the lower quote ranks first.
Enter the awarding screen.
Allocate the line to the first eligible vendor for the split-award flow.
Allocate the remaining award selection to the next eligible vendor; exact quantities are not configurable by this step.
Confirm the line and two-vendor award selections are represented on the awarding screen.
Create the proposal from the completed award selection.
Submit the award proposal.
Confirm that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase orders.
Confirm two purchase-order lines were created, the closest available check for two vendor POs.
Return to the events list to verify history placement.
Open the History tab.
Confirm this event appears in event history.
